posts.title: Simple Tips to Keep Your Diamond Jewellery Shining
posts.description: Easy, everyday care habits that keep your diamond jewellery as brilliant as the day you bought it.
posts.imageAlt: Model wearing pear diamond drop earrings and a matching ring

detail.intro: Diamond jewellery is more than just an accessory, it’s a symbol of love, elegance and cherished memories. With the right care and mindful habits, you can keep your favourite pieces looking as brilliant as the day you bought them.
detail.imageAlt: Diamond halo stud earrings on a marble block beside white flowers
detail.quote: A little care goes a long way in preserving the beauty and brilliance of your diamond jewellery. Follow these simple tips to keep your cherished pieces looking radiant for years to come.

sections.title: Keep Your Jewellery
sections.description: Regular cleaning helps maintain the natural shine of your diamond jewellery. Use a soft, lint-free cloth to gently wipe your pieces after wearing them. For a deeper clean, use a mild jewellery cleaner or lukewarm water with a few drops of gentle soap. Avoid harsh chemicals that can damage delicate stones and metals.

sections.title: Store Them
sections.description: Always store your jewellery in a soft-lined jewellery box or individual pouches to prevent scratches and tangling. Keep different pieces separate, especially those with diamonds or delicate designs. Proper storage not only keeps them safe but also helps maintain their brilliance for longer.

sections.title: Avoid Exposure to
sections.description: Remove your jewellery before swimming, exercising or using household cleaning products. Exposure to chlorine, sweat, perfumes and harsh chemicals can dull the shine and damage the metal or gemstones. Putting them on after your skincare and makeup routine is a good habit.

sections.title: Get Professional
sections.description: For valuable or frequently worn pieces, it’s a good idea to get them checked by a professional jeweller once in a while. They can inspect the settings, clean them thoroughly and ensure that your jewellery remains in perfect condition.

posts.title: Top Jewellery Trends You’ll Love This Season
posts.description: From stacked bands to sculptural gold, explore the trends our clients are falling in love with this season.
posts.imageAlt: Two diamond-set gold bands resting on a stone plinth with dried flowers

detail.intro: This season is all about pieces that feel personal, versatile and quietly luxurious. From stacked bands to sculptural gold, here are the trends our clients are falling in love with.
detail.imageAlt: Stacked gold eternity bands with diamonds
detail.quote: The best trends are the ones that feel like you. Choose pieces that layer easily, flatter your everyday style and still feel special years from now.

sections.title: Stacked
sections.description: Slim diamond bands worn together create a personalised look that grows with you. Mix yellow and rose gold, or combine plain and pavé bands for depth and texture.

sections.title: Sculptural
sections.description: Fluid, open cuffs with a single statement stone are replacing busy stacks. They feel modern on their own and add instant polish to both day and evening outfits.

sections.title: Colour With
sections.description: Deep red rubies paired with diamonds bring warmth and romance to classic designs. Look for marquise and pear shapes for a contemporary feel.

sections.title: Everyday
sections.description: Delicate halo pendants on fine chains remain a favourite. They are easy to wear daily and make thoughtful gifts for birthdays and anniversaries.

posts.title: How to Choose the Perfect Jewellery for Every Occasion
posts.description: Discover expert tips to select jewellery that matches your style, outfit and the moment beautifully.
posts.imageAlt: Model wearing pear diamond drop earrings and a matching ring

detail.intro: The right piece can complete an outfit and make a moment unforgettable. Here is how to choose jewellery that feels perfectly suited to every occasion.
detail.imageAlt: Diamond halo stud earrings on a marble block beside white flowers
detail.quote: Let the occasion guide the sparkle, and let your personal style guide the design.

sections.title: Everyday
sections.description: For daily wear, choose lightweight studs, slim bands and delicate pendants that are comfortable and easy to pair with any outfit.

sections.title: Work &
sections.description: Opt for refined, understated pieces — a classic pendant or small hoops add polish without distraction.

sections.title: Evenings &
sections.description: Drop earrings, statement necklaces and cocktail rings bring drama and light to evening looks. Balance one statement piece with simpler accents.

sections.title: Weddings &
sections.description: Diamonds and fine gold are timeless choices for life’s biggest moments. Coordinate metals with your outfit and choose pieces you will treasure for years.

detail.quote: The most beautiful jewellery tells a story — make sure it is yours.

sections.title: Consider the
sections.description: Pendants suit V-necks, collars suit strapless styles and drop earrings flatter high necklines.

posts.description: Minimal lines meet heirloom classics — discover how to balance both in your jewellery collection.

detail.intro: Minimal lines and heirloom classics are meeting in beautiful new ways. Discover how to balance both in your collection.

sections.title: Minimal
sections.description: Fine chains, slim bands and small studs create an effortless base for everyday wear.

sections.title: Timeless
sections.description: Tennis bracelets, solitaire rings and halo pendants never go out of style.

sections.title: Layer With
sections.description: Combine textures and lengths thoughtfully so every piece has room to shine.

sections.title: Care for
sections.description: Clean and store your pieces properly so they stay brilliant for generations.

posts.title: Caring for Your Gold Jewellery at Home
posts.description: A few simple habits keep your gold pieces bright and beautiful — here is how to care for them at home.
posts.imageAlt: Diamond halo stud earrings on a marble block beside white flowers

detail.intro: Gold is timeless, but a little care keeps it looking its best. Here is how to look after your pieces at home.
detail.imageAlt: Stacked gold eternity bands with diamonds
detail.quote: Treat your jewellery gently every day, and it will stay beautiful for a lifetime.

sections.title: Clean
sections.description: Soak your pieces in warm water with a drop of mild soap, then brush softly and pat dry.

sections.title: Store
sections.description: Keep each piece in its own soft pouch or lined compartment to avoid scratches and tangles.

sections.title: Avoid
sections.description: Remove jewellery before swimming, cleaning or applying perfume and lotions.

sections.title: Visit an
sections.description: Bring your pieces in once a year for a professional clean and a check of clasps and settings.
